observed: Two native XLSX attachment sessions lost their OLE parts on save; PPTX saved the identical Package payload.
sourceFindings: XclEscherEx::StartShape routes a non-chart SdrOle2Obj to XclObjOle.
XclObjOle declares binary Save/WriteSubRecs but no SaveXml override; XclObj also declares no SaveXml override.
SaveDrawingMLObjects calls SaveXml on collected objects; the XLSX result has an empty drawing part and no embedded part.
Shared ShapeExport::WriteOLE2Shape writes presentation OLE markup; using it unchanged is not a valid SpreadsheetML OLE export.
assessment: Strong evidence of missing XLSX OLE serialization in the pinned filter. A fix must emit worksheet oleObjects, embedded payload relations, matching shape identifiers and icon/anchor geometry; keep native model edits and preserve existing attachments. This source review is not proof of a implemented fix.
